topic: Sleep architecture: why stages matter for restoration
caption: Did you know your sleep has 3 main stages? 🛋️💤 Stage 1: transition, Stage 2: light sleep, and Stage 3: deep sleep. Each stage plays a critical role in restoration. 💪 Learn how to improve your sleep quality and wake up feeling refreshed! 🌞 Save this so you don't lose it. Share with someone who needs to see this.
